decision: one mutation gate per package, not one at the repo root
why: a survivor must name the package that owns it and a package can be fixed alone

decision: replaced hand-written parsers with decoder combinators
why: each decode reads as one rule and the branches became observable

decision: reused the protocol decoders for provider payloads
why: a malformed body becomes a 400 with the same rule the agent side uses

decision: made the thread index a Durable Object of its own
why: two webhooks for one thread can land on different session objects and must still agree

decision: ran a real pi-durable turn under bun with a scripted Pi AI provider
why: the design leans on pi-durable, so it had to work outside Cloudflare before anything was built on it

decision: kept pi-durable JSONL storage as the local adapter and pi's SQLite storage as the Cloudflare one
why: one conversation base has to persist in both places without a second transcript format

decision: made the runtime port one spawn, not a start/prompt/events object
why: the only thing that differs between a sandbox and a VM is where the bytes go, and the supervisor already owns the rest
result: both targets pass one conformance test

decision: keyed an execution call by its position in the pass, not by method name
why: a loop that calls one method twice would otherwise replay the wrong result

decision: kept one agent profile in the catalog and made a runtime list names
why: a copy per runtime let the two drift, and the mutation gate caught the unobserved copy

decision: recorded the router's choice on the session and never asked twice
why: a replay could otherwise move a live conversation to another agent

decision: recorded unobservable mutants per package with the pi behavior that hides them
why: the gate stays at 100% and each exception is justified once rather than deleted as dead code

decision: kept the Durable Object layer thin and put its logic in packages
why: workerd will not launch on this host, so the layer that cannot be run here must not hold logic

decision: refreshed the fixed-output hash for the dependency store after the new workspace links
why: the sandbox installs from the lockfile, so a new workspace package or a new dependency changes the store the checks read

decision: put the bound Durable Object classes on the platform entry, which wrangler requires
why: a deploy had served /health and failed every session call because the entry exported no Durable Object

decision: commented out the container binding until the account has the Workers Paid plan
why: the temporary preview account answered container provisioning with Forbidden

decision: deployed to the mokmok.dev account and restored the container binding
why: the login granted containers:write, so the sandbox target has its container

decision: kept a named discriminated union per boundary instead of one generic Result
why: a caller cannot read a value without narrowing, and each boundary's refusals differ: a signature has absent/mismatch/unusable, a decode has one shape message

decision: deleted the catch that inferred a status from an error message
why: the union carries the status, so a Durable Object RPC no longer has to have its error fields reconstructed
result: a refused callback answers 400 by construction
